title: Per-request similarity semantics toggle + preprocessing audit for reranker and embedding clients
creator: Priya Kapoor
description:
Problem: Clients and internal rerankers expect different similarity semantics (raw dot vs cosine-normalized dot). Some legacy clients send pre-normalized vectors, others rely on server-side normalization. This mismatch causes ranking regressions and unpredictable latency when we try to add runtime compatibility shims.

Goal: Provide a safe, observable migration path that: (1) allows per-request declaration of expected similarity semantics, (2) adds an audit-only mode that detects mismatches between client vectors and server expectations without changing responses, and (3) implements an optional lightweight server-side autocorrect scaler that preserves legacy dot-product behavior while keeping latency impact minimal. Deliverables include: API/SDK changes, runtime handling, observability dashboards, and canary rollout plan.
acceptance_criteria: API: SDK and REST accept an optional request field 'similarity_convention' with values 'dot', 'cosine', or 'inferred' (default 'inferred')

Audit mode: runtime can run in 'audit-only' for a route where mismatches between supplied vector norms and configured route convention are logged, with per-request sample of raw vectors stored in secure bucket for offline analysis

Autocorrect scaler: server implements a best-effort scalar correction algorithm (single float multiply) that can be toggled per-route; microbenchmarks show <=0.5ms median added latency for 512-d vectors on p3/ga-like hardware

Regression tests: rank-preservation harness included — end-to-end reranker evaluation shows delta-KendallTau < 0.01 and Recall@10 degradation < 0.5% when autocorrect is enabled for legacy clients across 3 canonical datasets
Rollout: feature gated behind runtime flags + console toggle; canary rollout to 5% traffic, with automated rollback if error-rate or latency SLO breaches
Docs: Console guide and SDK changelog published with migration recipe and example requests, including recommended batch sizes and normalization guidance
comments: 2025-02-28 - Priya Kapoor: Created ticket after customer support reported inconsistent reranking between mobile client (pre-normalizes) and server-side re-ranking path. Linked initial incident notes: https://confluence.redwood.ai/pages/ENG-INC-349

2025-03-01 - Diego Martinez: Spike complete. Benchmarked three approaches: (A) strict server normalization (always L2 normalize), (B) runtime autocorrect scalar, (C) per-request expected-mode header + shim. Chose combination of B+C for lowest latency + best ranking preservation. See spike notebook: https://drive.redwood.ai/drive/spikes/embeddings/similarity-spike-20250301.ipynb

2025-03-02 - Diego Martinez: Design decisions: 1) Use request field 'similarity_convention' in body to avoid extra headers for streaming clients; 2) 'inferred' mode computes simple heuristics (expected norm range) and marks potential mismatches without altering output unless autocorrect enabled; 3) autocorrect only applies a single scalar per-request (no per-dim ops) to keep kernel-friendly and cacheable. Added PR draft: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/4102

2025-03-03 - Alex Nguyen (PM review): Concern about telemetry volume if we log raw vectors. Agreed: store only sampled raw vectors (1/1000) to secure bucket with access logs; expanded audit fields include computed norm, expected_norm_range, and mismatch_reason. Alex asked for cost estimate for storage (added below).

2025-03-04 - Security (Maya Patel): Approved sampled storage with encryption + restricted IAM, recommended 90-day auto-retention and redact first/last token positions when storing embeddings tied to user payload. Noted security_review_required = false for runtime change but ops to implement IAM controls.

2025-03-05 - Diego Martinez: Implementation notes: runtime changes in two modules: preproc validation hook (adds cheap L2 norm calc), and vector-scaler path (vector *= scalar) inserted before KV caching to keep cache semantics stable. Added unit tests and a small perf harness. Draft dashboard panels for mismatch-rate, autocorrect-rate, avg added latency per route in Grafana: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/Embeddings/Similarity-Migration
